headings.h1: Area charts for volume and share

intro: Show cumulative or overlapping magnitude with filled regions under each series. AreaChart supports stacking via `stacked` and matching `stackId` values on series.
useCases: Traffic sources as a stacked composition.
Smoothed demand curves with fill emphasis.

faqs.question: When should I stack areas?
faqs.answer: Use stacking when parts compose a meaningful total; keep unstacked areas when overlap is intentional and totals are not additive.

faqs.question: Do fills respect theme colors?
faqs.answer: Series resolve palette strokes and fills; override with `color` or `fill` on each series when branding requires it.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Layers `Area` shapes with gradients friendly defaults.

Density and appearance tokens align with line and bar charts.

sections.heading: Data shape
sections.body: Same cartesian model: `xKey` for the shared axis, numeric keys per series.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body:
Ensure stacked fills remain distinguishable at reduced opacity.

Provide textual alternatives where precise values matter for compliance.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body: Import from `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/charts/area` inside client components when interaction is required.
